name: Pell Bio-Med Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Pell Bio-Med Technology Co., Ltd., a biomedical company, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of chimeric antigen recombinant T cell (CAR-T), and other related services and products. It offers autologous adipose-derived stem cell (ADSC) products to treat osteoarthritis and cartilage defects in the knee; cytokine-induced Killer cells to treat various tumors; and dendritic cell-activated cytokine-induced killer to treat solid tumors.
